title: Daily sales report uses the wrong day
instruction: Shops in India report that orders placed late in the evening show up on the wrong day in the daily sales report, and the per-day order drill-down doesn't add up to the daily totals. Both dailyTotals and ordersOn take the shop's UTC offset in minutes (330 for India, -300 for New York in winter). Make both group orders by the calendar day in the shop's timezone and make them agree with each other.
